goal: Remove application-level translation machinery dependencies from libbitcoinkernel
Replace string-based fatal and flush error notifications with typed errors across the kernel boundary
Move error string formatting and translation into the node layer
agreement: Concept approval without detailed review (sedited, yuvicc)
Objection that replacing C API callback messages with error codes drops details (ryanofsky, yuvicc)
Unaddressed suggestions on C API dynamic error details and debug assertions (Yudis-bit)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it decouples libbitcoinkernel from application-layer translation dependencies
Directly advances tracking issue #27587 by removing translation.h from the kernel
